editorial:
Ever feel like your ex owes you a huge apology? You will totally relate to Brea, Wendy, and Jessica. These three best friends are tired of getting their hearts broken by guys who just won't be honest. Instead of just crying over it, they decide to do something wild: they kidnap their ex-boyfriends and lock them up until they get the truth. It starts as a private revenge mission, but things get crazy when they start streaming the whole thing online. Suddenly, the entire world is watching their drama, and they become famous overnight for their battle of the exes.

You will love how the movie keeps things moving quickly with plenty of funny arguments and surprising moments. The acting feels natural, and you can really feel the friendship between the girls. While some of the plots are a bit over the top, it works for the kind of movie this is. If you want a fun night in, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture. You could also rent it on Apple TV or grab the 4K Blu-ray if you like owning your movies. It is a perfect pick for a girls night with snacks.
endingExplained: After all the fighting and public drama, the women finally get the honest answers they were looking for. The guys admit their faults and the truth comes out during the live streams. Instead of ending in a crime spree, the situation wraps up with the characters finding some peace. They realize that holding onto anger is a waste of time, and they eventually let their exes go to start fresh lives.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves revenge comedies and stories about female friendship.
